title: Auto-enter calculation crossing relationships
description: Performance rule — auto-enter calculations that read related fields traverse relationships on every write of the record. Over WAN each traversal can mean extra round trips at data-entry time.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: Writing a record evaluates its auto-enter calculations. When such a formula reads related fields, the relationship is resolved as part of the write — on remote clients this adds network work to every commit, invisible in the script that triggers it.
rule.remediation: Check whether the related value can be resolved once (lookup, script-set value) instead of per write, or whether the traversal is shallow enough to be harmless. This is a review pointer, not a defect list.

meta.name: Auto-enter calculation crossing relationships
meta.author: fm-lab rules
meta.description: Detects '::' (related-field syntax) in the auto-enter calculation text. False-positive classes documented: '::' inside string literals or formula comments counts as a match — hence severity info.
